_comment: External integrations the installer can detect and (on confirmation) install. Not skills: each runs a third-party installer or registers a plugin/MCP server. 'note' is informational.

impeccable.title: Impeccable - design vocabulary, refinement commands and design checks

figma-mcp.title: Figma MCP - live canvas and FigJam access for the agent

ppt-master.title: PPT Master - editable .pptx decks with native shapes, charts and brand templates

after_install.claude: restart Claude Code; pip install -r the skill's requirements.txt if you want its scripts

ppt-master.note: 78 MB upstream (templates), so it is installed locally rather than vendored into this repo

presentation-skill.title: presentation-skill - Codex-native editable .pptx builder with layout and accessibility QA

after_install.codex: restart Codex; read its SKILL.md before running its scripts

presentation-skill.note: 95 MB upstream with many scripts, so it is installed locally rather than vendored into this repo

anthropic-pptx.title: Anthropic pptx skill - read, create and edit PowerPoint files

claude: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill pptx --agent claude-code
codex: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill pptx --agent codex

after_install.claude: the Claude desktop app may already sync this skill; check Installed

anthropic-pptx.note: its LICENSE.txt forbids redistribution, so it is never vendored into this repo
